name: Dilmer Valecillos
title: Developer Advocate
bio: Over the past decade, Dilmer has worked in roles ranging from Full Stack Software Engineer to XR Developer, creating AR/VR tools and training simulations. He later became an XR consultant through his platform, "Learn XR," helping companies and developers adopt XR tools and SDKs. Now a Developer Advocate at Meta, he focuses on empowering developers by sharing insights and best practices. Passionate about XR, he has created 950+ development videos on YouTube and shares educational content on X, Instagram, and Threads. His mission is to make XR development more accessible and inspire the next generation of creators.
